# Libraries and data

Explanations for missing data for surveys:
- participant 23 did complete all surveys, but accidentally completed the survey after the CDM session after the FIRST day of the CDM session and it was therefore removed
- participant 12 did not complete the survey after the first intervention

Explanations for missing data for cardio:
- s04: participant very anxious about MRI scan, data removed
- s15: technical error during data acquisition, data removed
```{r}
rm(list=ls())

paths=list(base.path='/Users/jacquelinescholl/Documents/Experiments/Tim_Palmer/Cardio_forPublication')
paths$figures=file.path(paths$base.path,'Results','Figures_survey')
paths$stats=file.path(paths$base.path,'Results','Stats_survey')

library(tidyverse)
library(ggpattern)
library(ggpubr)  # for plotting
library("ggsci") # for color palets for plots
library(shinystan) # in detail inspection of stan models
library("rstan") # observe startup messages
options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())
rstan_options(auto_write = TRUE)
library(brms) # regression models
library(sjPlot) # makes tables of regression models
library(readxl)
library(stringr)
library(tableone) # make table


# Read the survey data
med.data= read.csv(file.path(paths$base.path,'Data','','Online_survey_forPublication.csv')) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(order=factor(order))

# Checks: count measures per participant (must never be more than 1)
count = med.data %>% dplyr::group_by(ID) %>% dplyr::summarize(count.Pre=sum(this.session.type.pre_NDM_CDM=='Pre'),
                                                                   count.NDM=sum(this.session.type.pre_NDM_CDM=='NDM'),
                                                                   count.CDM=sum(this.session.type.pre_NDM_CDM=='CDM'))

# Rename age and gender
med.data= med.data %>% dplyr::rename(Age=age.to.use,Sex=sex.to.use)

# get the IDs of participants who completed both cardio sessions so we can make sure we have that in the demographics
cardio.done.IDs = data.frame(fullID=list.files(file.path(paths$base.path,'Data','Cardio_rawData'))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(ID=stringr::str_remove(fullID,'_CDM|_NDM'),
                session=stringr::str_sub_all(fullID,-3,-1)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-fullID) %>% dplyr::group_by(ID) %>% dplyr::summarize(count.sessions=n())


# We have participants with questionnaires and/or with cardio data, let's make a list
IDs.sessions = full_join(count %>% dplyr::filter(count.NDM==1 & count.CDM==1) %>% dplyr::select(ID) %>% dplyr::mutate(surveys.done=1),
                         cardio.done.IDs %>% dplyr::filter(count.sessions==2) %>% dplyr::select(ID) %>% dplyr::mutate(cardio.done=1), by='ID')
```


# Demographics
We want to have a table with:
- age
- gender 
- education
- previous meditation experience (for different types + duration)
- mental health
- family history schizophrenia

Each person might have computed these measures at each - take the measures from baseline, and if absent from their session 1, if absent from session 2

Note that for NDM_use etc. i'm computing the mean, so it's easier for the reader to understand
```{r}
df= med.data %>% dplyr::select(ID, starts_with('Employment'),Education,starts_with('Schiz_Fam'), starts_with('Mental_Health'),
                               Trauma, Years_Med,Months_Med, starts_with('Traditions'),
                               starts_with('Use.Of.Techn'),this.session.type,Age,Sex,order) %>%
  # meditation techniques
  dplyr::mutate(NDM_use = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("Use.Of.Techniques_"))[, c(8,16,20,21,32)]),
                CDM_use = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("Use.Of.Techniques_"))[, c(2,4,9,24,25)]),
                ADM_use = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("Use.Of.Techniques_"))[, c(5,6,26,37,50)]),
  # Family history              
                Schiz_fam_summary = case_when(Schiz_Fam_1==1 ~7,
                                              Schiz_Fam_2==1 ~6,
                                              Schiz_Fam_3==1 ~5,
                                              Schiz_Fam_4==1 ~4,
                                              Schiz_Fam_5==1 ~3,
                                              Schiz_Fam_6==1 ~2,
                                              Schiz_Fam_7==1 ~1),
                Employment = case_when(Employment_3==1 ~ 'Unemployed',
                                       Employment_4==1 ~ 'Student',
                                       Employment_5==1 ~ 'Homemaker',
                                       Employment_6==1 ~ 'Retired',
                                       Employment_7==1 ~ 'On long-term sick leave',
                                       Employment_2==1 ~ 'Self-employed',
                                       Employment_1==1 ~ 'Employed')) %>%
  dplyr::select(-contains('Schiz_Fam'),-contains('Use.Of.Tech'),-contains('Traditions'),-contains('Employment_')) %>% #
  # Mental health
  dplyr::rename("MH_Depression"=Mental_Health_List_1, 
                "MH_Schizophrenia"=Mental_Health_List_2,
                "MH_Anxiety/panic"=Mental_Health_List_3, 
                "MH_Personality disorder"=Mental_Health_List_4,
                "MH_Bipolar"=Mental_Health_List_5, 
                "MH_Mania"=Mental_Health_List_6, 
                "MH_Eating disorder"=Mental_Health_List_7, 
                "MH_OCD"=Mental_Health_List_8, 
                "MH_Addiction"=Mental_Health_List_9,
                "MH_Psychotic episode"=Mental_Health_List_10, 
                "MH_Other"=Mental_Health_List_11, 
                "MH_PTSD"=Mental_Health_List_12) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Mental.Health.summary=Mental_Health) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Mental.Health = case_when(Mental.Health.summary==0 ~ 'None',
                                          MH_Depression ==1 & `MH_Eating disorder` ==1 & MH_Addiction==1 ~ "Depression, Eating disorder and addiction",
                                          MH_Depression==1 ~ 'Depression',
                                          MH_PTSD==1 ~ 'PTSD',
                                          `MH_Personality disorder`==1 ~ 'Personality disorder'))  %>%
  dplyr::select(-starts_with('MH_'),-Mental.Health.summary) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Education=recode(Education,`6`="College 16-18 years A-Levels", `7`="Some university 18+, no degree", `8`="Trade or vocational", 
                      `9`="Bachelor's degree", `10`="Master's degree", `11`="Doctorate"),
                Education=factor(Education,levels=c("College 16-18 years A-Levels", "Some university 18+, no degree","Trade or vocational", 
                      "Bachelor's degree", "Master's degree","Doctorate"),ordered=T)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(`Meditation duration (years)` = Years_Med+Months_Med/12) %>% dplyr::select(-Years_Med,-Months_Med)


write.csv(df,file=file.path(paths$stats,'Survey_demographics_fullTable.csv'))                  

df.singleValue = data.frame()
for (is in unique(df$ID)){
  df.sub=data.frame(ID=is)
  for (icol in colnames(df %>% dplyr::select(-ID))){
    t =df %>% dplyr::filter(ID==is)
    val.pre=t %>% dplyr::filter(this.session.type=='Pre') %>% pull(icol)
    val.sess1=t %>% dplyr::filter(this.session.type=='After 1st intervention') %>% pull(icol)
    val.sess2=t %>% dplyr::filter(this.session.type=='After 2nd intervention') %>% pull(icol)
    if (!length(val.pre)==0 && !is.na(val.pre)){
      df.sub[[icol]]=val.pre
    }  else if (!length(val.sess1)==0 && !is.na(val.sess1)){
      df.sub[[icol]]=val.sess1
    } else if (!length(val.sess2)==0 && !is.na(val.sess2)){
      df.sub[[icol]]=val.sess2
    } else{
      df.sub[[icol]]=NA
    }
  }
  df.singleValue =bind_rows(df.singleValue,df.sub)
}
write.csv(df.singleValue,file=file.path(paths$stats,'Survey_demographics_singleValueTable.csv'))  



# get participants who are used in the regressions
df=dplyr::left_join(df.singleValue ,IDs.sessions, by='ID') %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(surveys.done) | !is.na(cardio.done)) %>% dplyr::select(-ID)
table.allParticipants = CreateTableOne(data=df)
write.csv(print(table.allParticipants),file=file.path(paths$stats,'Survey_Demographics_allParticiapnts.csv'))

# specify what data available
df= dplyr::left_join(df.singleValue ,IDs.sessions, by='ID') %>%  #df.singleValue %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(data.availability=case_when(cardio.done==T & surveys.done==T ~ 'Cardio.and.Survey',
                                    cardio.done==T ~ 'Cardio.only',
                                    surveys.done==T ~ 'Survey.only',
                                    T ~ 'None' ),
                data.availability=factor(data.availability,ordered=T,levels=c('Cardio.and.Survey','Cardio.only','Survey.only','None'))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-cardio.done,-surveys.done)

table.splitParticipants.dataAvailable=CreateTableOne(data=df%>%dplyr::select(-ID),strata="data.availability")
write.csv(print(table.splitParticipants.dataAvailable),file=file.path(paths$stats,'Survey_Demographics_allParticiapnts_splitByDataAvailability.csv'))

```

## Figure demographics 
From the data frame df.singleValue created above, make two plots. In the first plot, visualize the Meditation duration (years). And in the second plot visualize NDM_use, CDM_use and ADM_use. The plots should be such that individual data points (i.e. rows) are visible, in addition to the mean and the standard deviation. The second plot,  should be faceted by the variable (i.e.  NDM_use, CDM_use and ADM_use). 

Plot this for all participants
```{r}
df.plot=df.singleValue  #left_join(df.singleValue,IDs.sessions,by='ID') %>% dplyr::filter(cardio.done==1) 
fontsize.axis=16
plot.technique.Use = df.plot%>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c('NDM_use','CDM_use','ADM_use'), names_to = 'Technique', values_to = 'Use') %>%
  ggplot(.,aes(x=Technique,y=Use,fill=Technique))+
  geom_dotplot(binaxis='y', stackdir='center')+
  theme_bw()+
  # remove _use from the x-tick labels
  # change the color of the dots for CDM to red and NDM to blue and ADM to black
  scale_fill_manual(values=c('CDM_use'='red','NDM_use'='blue','ADM_use'='black'))+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) gsub("_use", "", x)) +
  # limit the y-axis to -0.5 to 10
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(-0.5,10))+
  # add a left centered titel "B Prior technique experience"
  ggtitle('B Prior technique experience')+
  # remove the legend
  theme(legend.position = 'none')+
  # increase the fontsize of the axis labels to be the same as the title
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size=fontsize.axis),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=fontsize.axis),
        axis.title = element_text(size=fontsize.axis))

plot.meditation.duration = ggplot(df.plot,aes(x=`Meditation duration (years)`))+
  # make a histogram of the meditation duration of
  #geom_histogram(breaks = c(seq(0,1,1/12),seq(2,45,1)),fill='black')+  #binwidth=1,
  geom_histogram(binwidth=1,fill='grey',color='black')+  #
# Label the y-axis as "Number of participants"
# Label the x-axis as "Meditation duration (years)"
# Add a left centered title "A Meditation experience"
  ylab('Number of participants')+
  xlab('Meditation duration (years)')+
  ggtitle('Ai Prior meditation experience (years)')+
  #scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(round(seq(0,1,4/12),1),seq(5,45,5)))+
  theme_bw()+
   theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size=fontsize.axis),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=fontsize.axis),
        axis.title = element_text(size=fontsize.axis))

# zoomed in plot for <5 years meditation
plot.meditation.duration.lessThan1 = ggplot(df.plot%>%dplyr::filter(`Meditation duration (years)`<=1) %>% 
                                              dplyr::mutate(`Meditation duration (months)`= `Meditation duration (years)`*12),aes(x=`Meditation duration (months)`))+
  # make a histogram of the meditation duration of
  geom_histogram(breaks = seq(0,12,1),fill='grey',color='black')+  #binwidth=1,

# Label the y-axis as "Number of participants"
```

# Regressions for survey data

CAPE(CDM-NDM) ~ 1 + order. Note here that the result for order means 'the difference CDM-NDM depends on order'

## Preprocess the data
Notes:
- ThisQ: Item 8 not used - it should be part of gastroesophageal, so added there
- CAPE: Capra et al. 2013 boil the 20 item version down to 15 items. the 5 extra items need to be described in the paper
- I remove 'na.rm=T' because one should not be doing that with questionnaires, instead we need to impute if items are missing!!
- Mystical: I think we're using the 30 item version, item 30 seems to not feature in the subscales. There also seem to be 4 subscales, according to Barrett2015 and the item order seems to be very different. Asked Tim to check
- MAIA: we don't have reverse coded items because we left out the subscales with the reverse coded items

```{r}
df = med.data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CAPE.Pos_total =rowSums(select(., starts_with("CAPE_Pos"))),
                Mystical_total=rowSums(select(., starts_with("Mystical.1"))),
                Interoception_MAIA_total=rowSums(select(., starts_with("Interoception_"))),
                Decentering_total=rowSums(select(., starts_with("Decentering_"))),
                Interoception_ThisQ_total=rowSums(select(., starts_with("THISQ"))),
                # Subscales
                ThisQ_Cardiorespiratory_Activation_s = rowSums(select(., starts_with("THISQ_Interoception_"))[, c(4, 5, 6, 16, 17, 18)]),
                ThisQ_Cardiorespiratory_Deactivation_s = rowSums(select(., starts_with("THISQ_Interoception_"))[, c(1, 2, 3, 13, 14, 15)]),
                ThisQ_Gastroesophageal_Sensations_s = rowSums(select(., starts_with("THISQ_Interoception_"))[, c(7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12)]),
                Mystical_Mystical_s = rowSums(select(., starts_with("Mystical"))[, paste0("Mystical.1_", 1:15)]),
                Mystical_PositiveMood_s = rowSums(select(., starts_with("Mystical"))[, paste0("Mystical.1_", 16:21)]),
                Mystical_Space_Time_s = rowSums(select(., starts_with("Mystical"))[, paste0("Mystical.1_", 22:27)]),
                Mystical_Ineffability_s = rowSums(select(., starts_with("Mystical"))[, paste0("Mystical.1_", 28:30)]),
                MAIA_Noticing_s = rowSums(select(., starts_with("Interoception"))[, paste0("Interoception_", 1:4)]),
                MAIA_Attention_Regulation_s = rowSums(select(., starts_with("Interoception"))[, paste0("Interoception_", 5:11)]),
                MAIA_Emotional_Awareness_s = rowSums(select(., starts_with("Interoception"))[, paste0("Interoception_", 12:16)]),
                MAIA_Self_Regulation_s = rowSums(select(., starts_with("Interoception"))[, paste0("Interoception_", 17:20)]),
                MAIA_Body_Listening_s = rowSums(select(., starts_with("Interoception"))[, paste0("Interoception_", 21:23)]),
                MAIA_Trusting_s = rowSums(select(., starts_with("Interoception"))[, paste0("Interoception_", 24:26)]), # was 22 to 26
                CAPE_Bizarre_Exps_s = rowSums(select(., starts_with("CAPE_Pos"))[, paste0("CAPE_Pos_", c( 9, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 19))]), #JS:added 19, removed 2
                CAPE_Persecutory_Ideations_s = rowSums(select(., starts_with("CAPE_Pos"))[, paste0("CAPE_Pos_", c(1, 3, 4, 5, 11))]), #JS: relabed from delusional to persecutory, removed: 6, 7, 8, 10, 
                CAPE_Perceptual_Anomalies_s = rowSums(select(., starts_with("CAPE_Pos"))[, paste0("CAPE_Pos_", c(17,18,20))]))%>% # JS: changed 17:20
  dplyr::select(ID,contains('total'),contains('_s'),this.session.type.pre_NDM_CDM,order,Sex,Age)  
q.scales=colnames(df%>%dplyr::select(-ID,-this.session.type.pre_NDM_CDM,-order,-Sex,-Age))

# detect missing items
t= as.data.frame(which(is.na(df),arr.ind=T))
t2=df[unique(t$row),]

# Just needed for control analyses
df.pre = df %>% dplyr::filter(this.session.type.pre_NDM_CDM=='Pre') %>%
 # dplyr::rename(CAPE.Pos_pre=CAPE.Pos_total,Mystical_pre = Mystical_total) %>%
  dplyr::rename_with(~ paste0(.,'_pre'),-c(ID,order,Sex,Age)) 
   
df.wide=df %>%
  dplyr::filter(this.session.type.pre_NDM_CDM %in% c('CDM','NDM')) %>%
  pivot_wider(.,id_cols=c('ID','order','Sex','Age'),names_from='this.session.type.pre_NDM_CDM' , 
              values_from=-c('ID','order','Sex','Age','this.session.type.pre_NDM_CDM')) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(CAPE.Pos_total_CDM) & !is.na(CAPE.Pos_total_NDM))

for (is in q.scales){
  df.wide[[paste0(is,'_CDMminNDM')]] = df.wide[[paste0(is,'_CDM')]]-df.wide[[paste0(is,'_NDM')]]
}
df.wide.full=left_join(df.wide ,
                  df.pre %>% dplyr::select(ID,contains('pre')), by='ID') %>% dplyr::select(-this.session.type.pre_NDM_CDM_pre)

df.wide=left_join(df.wide %>%dplyr::select(-ends_with('_CDM'),-ends_with('_NDM')),
                  df.pre %>% dplyr::select(ID,contains('pre')), by='ID') %>% dplyr::select(-this.session.type.pre_NDM_CDM_pre)


# For illustrations
df.long=df %>% dplyr::filter(this.session.type.pre_NDM_CDM %in% c('CDM','NDM')) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(testing.day = case_when(this.session.type.pre_NDM_CDM =='CDM' & order=='CDM.first' ~ 1,

                                        this.session.type.pre_NDM_CDM =='NDM' & order=='NDM.first' ~ 1)) %>%
  left_join(.,df.pre %>% dplyr::select(ID,contains('pre')), by='ID') %>%
  dplyr::rename(NDM.or.CDM=this.session.type.pre_NDM_CDM )
```

## Run the models 
In the paper, we only have Cdm_minNDM~1+oder, but as control analyses, we do more here.

Note:
- for CAPE perceptual anamolaies, there was not enough variability across participants to run the model (sum of three questions and most people ticked the lowest answer for each)

```{r}
overwrite=T
subscales = stringr::str_remove_all(colnames(df.wide %>% dplyr::select(contains('CDMminNDM'))),'_CDMminNDM')

models.file=file.path(paths$base.path,'Data_preprocessed','Surveys_regressions','Survey_models.RData')
if (!file.exists(models.file)|overwrite==T){
  this.scaled='scaled'
  all.bfs=data.frame()
  #Wide models
  models.wide.byM= list()
  models.wide.bySubsc= list()
  for (isc in setdiff(subscales,'CAPE_Perceptual_Anomalies_s')){
    
    dfT = df.wide %>% dplyr::select(contains(isc),Sex,Age,order,ID) %>% na.omit() 
    dfT=dfT%>%
        dplyr::mutate_at(vars(c(contains('_pre'),Age)),scale)
  
    models.wide.bySubsc[[isc]] = list()
    models.wide.bySubsc[[isc]]$orderOnly = lm(formula=paste0(isc,'_CDMminNDM~1+order'),data=dfT)
    models.wide.bySubsc[[isc]]$order_Demogr = lm(formula=paste0(isc,'_CDMminNDM~1+order+Sex+Age'),data=dfT)
    models.wide.bySubsc[[isc]]$order_preClin = lm(formula=paste0(isc,'_CDMminNDM~1+order+',isc,'_pre'),data=dfT)
    models.wide.bySubsc[[isc]]$preClinOnly = lm(formula=paste0(isc,'_CDMminNDM~1+',isc,'_pre'),data=dfT)
    models.wide.bySubsc[[isc]]$order_preClin_Demogr = lm(formula=paste0(isc,'_CDMminNDM~1+order+',isc,'_pre+Sex+Age'),data=dfT)
    models.wide.bySubsc[[isc]]$order_preClin_Interact_Demogr = lm(formula=paste0(isc,'_CDMminNDM~1+order*',isc,'_pre'),data=dfT)

    # # Computing a Bayes Factor for the absence of an effect

    #models.wide.bySubsc[[isc]]$orderOnly_BF=BFs
                                                           
    # The same models, but reordered for making easy tables
    models.wide.byM$orderOnly[[isc]]           = models.wide.bySubsc[[isc]]$orderOnly 
    models.wide.byM$order_Demogr[[isc]]        = models.wide.bySubsc[[isc]]$order_Demogr

    # Print files
    
  }
  for (itype in setdiff(names(models.wide.byM),'orderOnly_BF')){
    print(tab_model(models.wide.byM[[itype]],file=file.path(paths$stats,paste0('Survey_wideModels_allSubscales__',itype,'.html'))))
  }
  for (itype in names(models.wide.bySubsc)){
    t=models.wide.bySubsc[[itype]]
    t=t[names(t) != "orderOnly_BF"]
                
    print(tab_model(t,file=file.path(paths$stats,paste0('Survey_wideModels_allTypes__',itype,'.html'))))
  }
  out= list(models.wide.byM=models.wide.byM,models.wide.bySubsc=models.wide.bySubsc)
  save(out,models.wide.bySubsc,file=models.file)
} else{
  load(models.file)
  models.wide.byM=out$models.wide.byM
  models.wide.bySubsc=out$models.wide.bySubsc
}
```

# Print results for the paper - stats for regression models: 
columns: session 1 cdm, s1 ndm, s2 cdm, s2 ndm, p-value on intercept (cdm min ndm), p-value on interaction (1st session is cdm/ndm)
```{r}
# compute the values for session 1, session2 cdm/ndm
t=df %>% dplyr::filter(this.session.type.pre_NDM_CDM %in% c('CDM','NDM')) %>% dplyr::group_by(this.session.type.pre_NDM_CDM, order) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-ID,-Sex,-Age) %>%  dplyr::summarize_all(mean,na.rm=T)
mean.values=t %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(this.session.type.pre_NDM_CDM,order), names_to = 'quest') %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(this.session.type.pre_NDM_CDM,order), values_from = value) %>%
  dplyr::mutate_if(is.numeric,~format(round(.,digits=1), nsmall = 1))
t=df %>% dplyr::filter(this.session.type.pre_NDM_CDM %in% c('CDM','NDM')) %>% dplyr::group_by(this.session.type.pre_NDM_CDM, order) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-ID,-Sex,-Age) %>%  dplyr::summarize_all(sd,na.rm=T)
sd.values=t %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(this.session.type.pre_NDM_CDM,order), names_to = 'quest') %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(this.session.type.pre_NDM_CDM,order), values_from = value) 

# merge the two data frames mean.values and sd.values so that the matching columns are combined for example for the row with column entry quest=CAPE.Pos_total, the entry for CDM_CDM.first should be 30.4 (5.30). In other words it should be the mean value from mean.values and then in round brackets the sd from sd.values. 
mean.values.toPrint= left_join(mean.values,sd.values,by='quest') %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CDM_CDM.first = paste0(CDM_CDM.first.x,' (',round(CDM_CDM.first.y,digits=2),')'),
                NDM_NDM.first = paste0(NDM_NDM.first.x,' (',round(NDM_NDM.first.y,digits=2),')'),
                CDM_NDM.first = paste0(CDM_NDM.first.x,' (',round(CDM_NDM.first.y,digits=2),')'),
                NDM_CDM.first = paste0(NDM_CDM.first.x,' (',round(NDM_CDM.first.y,digits=2),')')) %>%
  dplyr::select(-contains('.x'),-contains('.y')) %>%
  dplyr::relocate(quest,CDM_CDM.first,NDM_NDM.first,CDM_NDM.first,NDM_CDM.first)

# attach the p-values
p.values = as.data.frame(sapply(models.wide.byM$orderOnly, function(x) summary(x)$coefficients[,4])) %>% rownames_to_column() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(rowname), names_to = 'quest') %>% pivot_wider(names_from = c(rowname), values_from = value) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Int.p = `(Intercept)`, order.p= orderNDM.first)
est = as.data.frame(sapply(models.wide.byM$orderOnly, function(x) summary(x)$coefficients[,1])) %>% rownames_to_column() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(rowname), names_to = 'quest') %>% pivot_wider(names_from = c(rowname), values_from = value) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Int.est = `(Intercept)`, order.est= orderNDM.first)
st.err = as.data.frame(sapply(models.wide.byM$orderOnly, function(x) summary(x)$coefficients[,2])) %>% rownames_to_column() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(rowname), names_to = 'quest') %>% pivot_wider(names_from = c(rowname), values_from = value) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Int.se = `(Intercept)`, order.se= orderNDM.first)
#BF = data.frame(BF=sapply(models.wide.byM$orderOnly_BF, function(x) x$hypothesis$Evid.Ratio)) %>% rownames_to_column(var='quest')
stats= left_join(p.values,est,by='quest') %>% left_join(.,st.err,by='quest') %>% #left_join(.,BF,by='quest')%>%
  dplyr::mutate(order.p= case_when(order.p<0.01 ~ format(round(order.p,digits=3), nsmall = 3),
                                   T ~ format(round(order.p,digits=2), nsmall = 2)),
                `NDM vs CDM, mean(s.e.)` = paste0(round(Int.est,digits=2),' (',round(Int.se,digits=1),')'),
                `Order [NDM first], mean(s.e.)` = paste0(round(order.est,digits=2),' (',round(order.se,digits=1),')'),
                `NDM vs CDM (p)`=case_when(Int.p<0.01 ~ round(Int.p,digits=3),
                                T ~ round(Int.p,digits=2))) %>% #,
             #   BF = round(BF,digits=1)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(`Order [NDM first] (p)`=order.p) %>%#`BF NDM vs CDM ==0` = BF,
  dplyr::select(quest,`NDM vs CDM, mean(s.e.)`,`NDM vs CDM (p)`,`Order [NDM first], mean(s.e.)`,`Order [NDM first] (p)`) #`BF NDM vs CDM ==0`,


intervention.comparison.table.toPrint= left_join(mean.values.toPrint,stats,by='quest') %>%
  dplyr::rename("CDM, session 1"=CDM_CDM.first, "CDM, session 2"=CDM_NDM.first,"NDM, session 1"=NDM_NDM.first,"NDM, session 2"=NDM_CDM.first)
write.csv(intervention.comparison.table.toPrint,file.path(paths$stats,'Survey_Paper_means_stats.csv'))
```

# Figure: CAPE and interoception and mystical
```{r}
df= rbind(df.long %>% dplyr::select(ID,CAPE.Pos_total,Interoception_MAIA_total,Mystical_total, NDM.or.CDM,order),
          df.pre  %>% dplyr::select(ID,CAPE.Pos_total_pre,Interoception_MAIA_total_pre,Mystical_total_pre,order) %>% 
            dplyr::mutate(NDM.or.CDM='pre')%>%
            dplyr::rename(CAPE.Pos_total=CAPE.Pos_total_pre,Interoception_MAIA_total=Interoception_MAIA_total_pre,Mystical_total=Mystical_total_pre)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c('CAPE.Pos_total','Interoception_MAIA_total','Mystical_total'), names_to = 'quest')  %>%
  dplyr::mutate(NDM.or.CDM=factor(NDM.or.CDM, ordered=T,levels=c('pre','CDM','NDM'))) %>%
  dplyr::filter(ID %in% df.wide$ID) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(quest=recode(quest,"CAPE.Pos_total"="Psychosis-like exp. (CAPE)","Interoception_MAIA_total"='Interoception (MAIA)','Mystical_total'='Mystical exp.')) 

# take the dataframe df and create plots of CAPE.Pos_total and of MAIA_Body_Listening_s which has on the x-axis NDM.or.CDM (with the order Pre, CDM, then NDM) and the facets are CAPE.Pos_total vs MAIA_Body_Listening_s and order. The colour should be red for CDM and blue for NDM. The plots should show the individual participants as coloured dots, with lines connecting each participant's values from Pre to CDM to NDM. These lines should be black. There should also be a dot for the mean and standard errors showing the standard error of the mean. The y-axis should be the value of the quest and the x-axis should be the order of the session. The x-axis should be labelled 'Session order' and the y-axis should be labelled 'Value'. The title of the plot should be 'Body listening and positive symptoms'. The font size of the axis labels should be 16. 
fontsize.axis=16
dodge_width=0.3
p= ggplot(df,aes(x=NDM.or.CDM,y=value,colour=NDM.or.CDM))+
  geom_line(aes(group=ID,color='black'),size=0.5)+
  # plot the individual IDs as points with doding their positions slightly to the side
  geom_point(aes(shape=order),size=2,alpha=0.5,position=position_jitterdodge(dodge.width=0.9))+
  #geom_point(aes(shape=order),size=2,alpha=0.5,position=position_dodge(width=dodge_width))+
  stat_summary(fun=mean, geom="point", aes(shape=order),size=3)+
  stat_summary(fun.data=mean_se, geom="errorbar", width=0.2)+
  facet_grid(quest~order,scales='free')+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(x='Session order',y='Value')+
  ggtitle('')+
  theme(axis.text=element_text(size=fontsize.axis),
        axis.title=element_text(size=fontsize.axis),
        legend.position = 'none')+
  # color NDM red and CDM blue and pre black, by explicitly defining which value gets which colour rather than relying on their order
  scale_colour_manual(values=c('pre'='black','CDM'='blue','NDM'='red'))
  
  # Save the figure with ggexport to the figures folder
ggexport(p,filename =file.path(paths$figures,'Survey_Cape_Mystical_Interoception.tiff'),width=10*400,height=7*400,res=400)
```

# Reviewer requests during revision
"I think that any analyses should be corrected for age, years of practice, specific meditation practiced"
Questionnaires:
- statistical tests table S2 (illustrated in figure 3 main text)

Results:
[1] including all covariates (age, sex, meditation duration, NDM, CDM, ADM use): 
-ThisQ_Cardiorespiratory_Activation_s_CDMminNDM, p of intercept now: 0.041, esimate: -2.41
- MAIA_Body_Listening_s_CDMminNDM , p of intercept: 0.043 estimate: -1.98
[2] controlling for age and sex:
- ThisQ_Cardiorespiratory_Activation_s_CDMminNDM p=0.025
+ looked trhoguh all: it's the inclusion of age and sex that has this effect
```{r}
df.wide=read.csv(file=file.path(paths$base.path,'Data','Survey_wide_subcales.csv'))
# add age, sex, years of practice, specific meditation practice (their CDM and NDM scores)
df.demographics = read.csv(file=file.path(paths$stats,'Survey_demographics_singleValueTable.csv'))  

df= left_join(df.wide,df.demographics %>% dplyr::select(ID,contains('use'),Meditation.duration..years.),by=c('ID')) %>% dplyr::select(-X)


overwrite=F
subscales = stringr::str_remove_all(colnames(df.wide %>% dplyr::select(contains('CDMminNDM'))),'_CDMminNDM')

models.file=file.path(paths$base.path,'Data_preprocessed','Surveys_regressions','Survey_models_controlAnalyses.RData')
if (!file.exists(models.file)|overwrite==T){
  this.scaled='scaled'
  all.bfs=data.frame()
  #Wide models
  models.wide.byM= list()
  models.wide.bySubsc= list()
  for (isc in setdiff(subscales,'CAPE_Perceptual_Anomalies_s')){
    
    dfT = df %>% dplyr::select(contains(isc),Sex,Age,order,ID,Meditation.duration..years.,contains('_use')) %>% na.omit() %>%
        dplyr::mutate_at(vars(Age,Meditation.duration..years.,contains('use')),scale)
  
    models.wide.bySubsc[[isc]] = list()
    models.wide.bySubsc[[isc]]$orderAgeSexMeditExpTypes = lm(formula=paste0(isc,'_CDMminNDM~1+order+Age+Sex+Meditation.duration..years.+NDM_use+CDM_use+ADM_use'),data=dfT)
    models.wide.bySubsc[[isc]]$orderAgeSex = lm(formula=paste0(isc,'_CDMminNDM~1+order+Age+Sex'),data=dfT)
    models.wide.bySubsc[[isc]]$orderMeditExp = lm(formula=paste0(isc,'_CDMminNDM~1+order+Meditation.duration..years.'),data=dfT)
    models.wide.bySubsc[[isc]]$orderMeditTypes = lm(formula=paste0(isc,'_CDMminNDM~1+order+NDM_use+CDM_use+ADM_use'),data=dfT)


                                                           
    # The same models, but reordered for making easy tables
    models.wide.byM$orderAgeSexMeditExpTypes[[isc]]  = models.wide.bySubsc[[isc]]$orderAgeSexMeditExpTypes 
    models.wide.byM$orderAgeSex[[isc]]               = models.wide.bySubsc[[isc]]$orderAgeSex 
    models.wide.byM$orderMeditExp[[isc]]             = models.wide.bySubsc[[isc]]$orderMeditExp 
    models.wide.byM$orderMeditTypes[[isc]]           = models.wide.bySubsc[[isc]]$orderMeditTypes 
    

    # Print files
    
  }
  for (itype in setdiff(names(models.wide.byM),'orderOnly_BF')){
    print(tab_model(models.wide.byM[[itype]],file=file.path(paths$stats,paste0('Survey_wideModels_allSubscales__',itype,'_reviewerAnalyses.html'))))
  }
  for (itype in names(models.wide.bySubsc)){
    t=models.wide.bySubsc[[itype]]
    t=t[names(t) != "orderOnly_BF"]
                
    print(tab_model(t,file=file.path(paths$stats,paste0('Survey_wideModels_allTypes__',itype,'_reviewerAnalyses.html'))))
  }
  out= list(models.wide.byM=models.wide.byM,models.wide.bySubsc=models.wide.bySubsc)
  save(out,models.wide.bySubsc,file=models.file)
} else{
  load(models.file)
  models.wide.byM=out$models.wide.byM
  models.wide.bySubsc=out$models.wide.bySubsc
}

p.values = as.data.frame(sapply(models.wide.byM$orderAgeSexMeditExpTypes, function(x) summary(x)$coefficients[,4])) %>% rownames_to_column() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(rowname), names_to = 'quest') %>% pivot_wider(names_from = c(rowname), values_from = value) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Int.p = `(Intercept)`, order.p= orderNDM.first)
# append results to table from manuscript
intervention.comparison.table_revision=read.csv(file.path(paths$stats,'Survey_Paper_means_stats.csv'))
t= left_join(intervention.comparison.table_revision,
             p.values %>% dplyr::select(quest,Int.p) %>% dplyr::rename(Int.p_controls=Int.p),by='quest') %>%
  # round 2 digits for printing
  dplyr::mutate(Int.p_controls = case_when(Int.p_controls<0.01 ~ format(round(Int.p_controls,digits=3), nsmall = 3),
                                   T ~ format(round(Int.p_controls,digits=2), nsmall = 2))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-X) %>%
  # rename to make look nice
  dplyr::rename(`quest subscale`=quest, `CDM, session 1` = CDM..session.1, `NDM, session 1`=NDM..session.1,`CDM, session 2`=CDM..session.2,`NDM, session 2`=NDM..session.2,
                `CDM min NDM, mean (s.e.)`=NDM.vs.CDM..mean.s.e.., `CDM min NDM (p)`=NDM.vs.CDM..p.,
                `Order [NDM first], mean(s.e.)`=Order..NDM.first...mean.s.e..,`Order [NDM first] (p)`=Order..NDM.first...p.,
                `CDM min NDM (p), with control vars`= Int.p_controls) 
write.csv(t,file.path(paths$stats,'Survey_Paper_means_stats_controlVarsAgeSexMeditYearsMedTypes.csv'))
```
